test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was introduced as the 101st Amendment of the Constitution of India on July 1, 2017?

options.text: Land boundary agreement between India and Bangladesh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Goods and Service Tax.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goods and Service Tax**

 
 
• Goods and Service Tax is officially known as** The Constitution (One Hundred and First Amendment) Act, 2016.**
 
• This amendment introduced a national Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India on **1 July 2017.**
 
• It was introduced as the** One Hundred and one Amendment Bill** of the Constitution of India.
 
• The Goods and Services Tax (GST) is a **Value added Tax (VAT).**
 
• It proposed to be a comprehensive indirect tax levy on the manufacture, sale, and consumption of goods as well as services at the national level.
 
• It replaces all indirect taxes levied on goods and services by the Indian Central and state governments.
 
• It is aimed at being comprehensive for most goods and services.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Listed are the **major objectives** that aspired to be accomplished by implementing GST under the 101 constitutional amendment act 2016.

 
 
• The fundamental objective of GST was to build a common market with a constant tax rate in India.
 
• The goods and services tax eradicates the initial taxes for the same transaction as input tax credits.
 
• There is** no export tax **as GST boosts exports by refunding the amount collected on the inputs.
 
• It seeks to increase revenue as it brings **more taxpayers** by growing the tax base.
 
• The procedure of application and return of tax has been simplified with the use of common forms. 
 
• Tax payment and form submission became convenient with the introduction of online payment gateways.
 
• A unified information technology system called **Goods and Services Network (GSTN) **got operated for simple GST operation.
